title: It’s a No from me
text: It’s a No from me. Not as pictured- much more orange. I was going for a cozy rust color and this looks like it belongs in a little boys room. The print itself looks cheap and the quality of the fabric stinks. Didn’t even bother putting it on the bed.

product_metadata.title: Mengersi Bow Duvet Cover Queen Size,Black and White Boho Printed Reversible Design Zipper Comforter Cover with Ties and 2 Pillowcase
features: 【Design】Bow on one side,solid on the other size,with zipper closure and corner ties to keep the duvet non-slip
【Pckage include】1 duvet cover 90x90 inches ,2 pillow shams 26x20 inches(No comforter or duvet insert)
【Material】 100% Washed Microfiber , soft, natural, breathable, machine washable.

【Duvet Cover】It's not a duvet! It's a DUVET COVER. You can slip a duvet inside of it. Its job is to keep your duvet clean and bedroom decor, so you can simply wash the cover regularly, rather than the whole duvet,which will extend duvet life.
【Easy Care】Machine wash in cold water, gentle cycle, tumble dry at low heat, do not bleach.
